name: 施世濠
objective: 本課程內容包括﹕熱力學第一定律、熱力學第二定律、結合兩定律之可用能、單相系統、可用能分析、多相系統、動力廠、冷凍、熱力最佳化、不可逆熱力學。
schedule:
1. (1) Course outline, (2) WHAT IS THERMAL SYSTEMS ENGINEERING? & 
    (3) THERMODYNAMICS:INTRODUCTORY CONCEPTS AND DEFINITIONS
2. USING ENERGY AND THE FIRST LAW OF THERMODYNAMICS
3. EVALUATING PROPERTIES (1)
4. EVALUATING PROPERTIES (2)
5. Review of Closed System
6. CONTROL VOLUME ANALYSIS USING ENERGY (Steady-State Steady-Flow) (1)
7. CONTROL VOLUME ANALYSIS USING ENERGY (Steady-State Steady-Flow) (2)
8. Mid-term Exam 
9. CONTROL VOLUME ANALYSIS USING ENERGY (Uniform-State Uniform-Flow)
10. Review of Control Volume
11. USING ENTROPY (1)
12. USING ENTROPY (2)
13. VAPOR POWER AND REFRIGERATION SYSTEMS
14. Gas Mixtures
15. PSYCHROMETRIC APPLICATIONS 
16. Final Exam
scorePolicy:
出席與作業 70% (10%/次出席與作業)
考試 20%
彈性學習 10%
materials:
Cengel, Y.A., and M. A. Boles. 2015. “Thermodynamics : an engineering Eight h
edition.
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
